# Alexis Thierry-Bellefond - Creative Developer & Engineer

> Alexis Thierry-Bellefond is a Paris-based creative full-stack developer and engineering student. This portfolio presents his web, mobile and software work, with an emphasis on complete systems: interface, business logic, data, deployment and runtime reliability.

The portfolio is available in English and French. It is a single-page site with sections for selected projects, working method, technical capabilities, side projects, professional journey and contact details.

Alexis builds with React, Next.js, React Native, Python, Node.js, PHP, MySQL and related deployment tooling. His work spans web applications, PWAs, Android experiences, APIs, authentication, offline support, infrastructure and developer tools.

For contact, use the portfolio contact form or email [contact@alexistb.com](mailto:contact@alexistb.com).

## Portfolio

- [Alexis Thierry-Bellefond portfolio](https://alexistb.com/): Primary source for the portfolio, biography, skills, experience and current selected work.

## Selected projects

- [EpiTime](https://epitime.epita.it/): Cross-platform timetable for EPITA, available on the web, as a PWA and on Android. It includes Microsoft sign-in, offline caching, course reminders and widgets.
- [EpiTime source code](https://github.com/alexistb2904/EpiTime): Public source repository for EpiTime.
- [WorkshopRessources](https://workshopressources.fr/): Community platform for game-content creators with accounts, structured resources, search and community publishing; maintained since 2021.
- [ReFlect](https://reflect-dev.com/): FiveM licensing and operations platform with Discord access, server-bound licence activation, client and administration dashboards, logs, team access and service-status visibility.
